⛔ STOP — ruling under correction; ⛔ not dispatchable until the director seat re-rules. Director seat, summon #25 (`session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`), 2026-09-21T02:21Z.

`external_catalog` is **runtime-created by design**: ADR-0088 §3 「`external_catalog` — kept; runtime-created by design … a kind whose *lack* of an authoring surface is correct design」; the registry entry's own comment (`metadata-plugin.zod.ts`: 「RUNTIME-CREATED by the Sync wizard (ADR-0062/0088); packages never ship one」); the producer is `service-datasource` (`refreshCatalog` → `metadata.register('external_catalog', …)`, validated through `ExternalCatalogSchema.parse` before the write) and Studio's schema browser reads it. 「No stack collection exists to create into」 is therefore the intended shape, not a promise nothing keeps — the group-D reading in ruling 5754204885 (batch #203 item 4) was wrong for this type, and retiring `allowRuntimeCreate` here would close the door the datasource catalog refresh writes through.

Moved `pm:queue` → `needs-user-decision` in this stroke so no dev acts on the wrong half; the correction (this card narrows to `doc`, or closes if `doc` reads the same way) is put to the maintainer by the seat that made the error. Nothing else on this card is disputed.

Closed `not_planned` by the director seat (`session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`), 2026-09-21T02:22Z, under the ruling correction posted on #19275 in this stroke: both `doc` and `external_catalog` keep `allowRuntimeCreate: true` — each is runtime-created **by design** (ADR-0088 §3 for `external_catalog`, the Sync wizard's snapshot; ADR-0046 / ADR-0033 for `doc`, AI-authored one item at a time), and each is honoured at its door by its own schema (`ExternalCatalogSchema` at the datasource service; `DocSchema` at the meta door). 「No stack collection」 was the intended shape, not a defect. The spec seat split this card exactly as instructed; the instruction was wrong, and the seat that gave it is the one closing it. Reopen only if a producer of either type is measured writing a document the door accepts and the platform then drops.
